Glue.name: Glue
Glue.description: Water-based adhesive for strong bonds on porous materials like wood and paper.
Glue.more_detail:
Glue is a versatile adhesive commonly used for woodworking, paper crafting, it also adds gloss or sheen and even some construction applications. It is water-based, dries clear, and forms a strong bond with porous materials like wood and paper.

Coverage: [5 to 10 square matter /1kg]
Finish: Gloss
Drying Time: ≈ [30 min to 1 hours].
Application: Brush, Roller, Spray
